newsitem.title: USA: U.S. to sell $24 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Mar 10.
newsitem.headline: U.S. to sell $24 billion of 3-, 6-mo bills Mar 10.

text.p: The Treasury Department said on Tuesday it will auction $24 billion of three- and six-month bills on March 10 to pay down $250 million as $24.246 billion of bills are maturing.
The weekly bill sale will be equally divided between the two maturities. The bills will be issued on March 13. The three-month bills mature on June 12 and the six-month bills mature on September 11.
The CUSIP number for the three-month bills is 9127944M3 and for the six-month bills is 9127945M2.
